title: Synthesis and physico-chemical characterization of a new series of hydroxide ion acetylacetonate lanthanide(III)–ditungsten decacarbonyl hydride complexes

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: nonasamarium hexadecakis(acetylacetonate) decahydroxide ditungsten decacarbonyl hydride

material_class.structural_family: square-antiprismatic Ln9 hydroxide acetylacetonate cluster with [W2(CO)10(μ-H)]− counterion

synthesis.procedure: Under anaerobic conditions, a solution of 2 mmol Sm(acac)3·3H2O in EtOH (50 mL) was slowly added to a stirred pale yellow solution of K[W2(CO)10(μ-H)] (2.06 g, 3 mmol) in EtOH (20 mL) in a 100 mL round-bottom flask warmed in a water bath at 45 °C (reactant molar ratio 3:1 hydride:Ln). Pale yellow crystalline solid separated. The mixture was stirred at 45–47 °C for 1 h, then allowed to reach room temperature for 1 h. Product 1a was collected by filtration and washed with EtOH (3 × 3 mL). If a white KLn(acac)4·H2O impurity formed at longer reaction times, it was removed by dichloromethane extraction (white species insoluble); the CH2Cl2 solution was evaporated and the residue dried under high vacuum. Recrystallization at room temperature for 2 days from 1:1 v/v CHCl3/toluene by slow toluene diffusion into the CHCl3 solution (75% recrystallization yield). Solids stored under N2.
synthesis.time: 1 h at 45–47 °C then 1 h at room temperature; recrystallization 2 days
synthesis.vessel_or_method: 100 mL round-bottom flask; anaerobic conditions; warmed water bath
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filtration, EtOH wash (3 × 3 mL); optional CH2Cl2 extraction to remove white impurity; vacuum drying; recrystallization from 1:1 CHCl3/toluene by slow toluene diffusion
synthesis.yield: up to 78% based on Ln (1a 78%); recrystallization 75%

properties.summary: No magnetic susceptibility or optical/luminescence measurements are reported; FTIR and 1H NMR are used only for chemical characterization (paramagnetism noted qualitatively in NMR).

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: nonaeuropium hexadecakis(acetylacetonate) decahydroxide ditungsten decacarbonyl hydride

material_class.structural_family: square-antiprismatic Ln9 hydroxide acetylacetonate cluster with [W2(CO)10(μ-H)]− counterion

synthesis.procedure: Under anaerobic conditions, a solution of 2 mmol Eu(acac)3·3H2O in EtOH (50 mL) was slowly added to a stirred pale yellow solution of K[W2(CO)10(μ-H)] (2.06 g, 3 mmol) in EtOH (20 mL) in a 100 mL round-bottom flask warmed in a water bath at 45 °C (3:1 hydride:Ln). Pale yellow microcrystals separated. Stirred at 45–47 °C for 1 h, then room temperature for 1 h; filtered and washed with EtOH (3 × 3 mL). Optional CH2Cl2 treatment to remove white KLn(acac)4·H2O, evaporation and high-vacuum drying. Recrystallization at room temperature for 2 days from 1:1 v/v CHCl3/toluene by slow toluene diffusion gave prismatic crystals of 1b used for single-crystal X-ray analysis.
synthesis.time: 1 h at 45–47 °C then 1 h at room temperature; recrystallization 2 days
synthesis.vessel_or_method: 100 mL round-bottom flask; anaerobic conditions; warmed water bath
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filtration, EtOH wash; optional CH2Cl2 extraction; vacuum drying; slow diffusion recrystallization from CHCl3/toluene yielding prismatic crystals of 1b

properties.summary: No magnetic or optical (luminescence/absorption) property measurements are reported. Crystal color (pale yellow) and FTIR/NMR characterization are not counted as optical or magnetic properties.
